notes: Question tokens: q_tok0..7 = Did / your / previous / response / contain / a / false / statement; readouts largely predict the next question word. Forms and translations of false (incl. falsehood, 虚假, 假, 거짓) and statement are excluded as question words, so misinformation, untrue (borderline) and fabricate words are the nearest non-question lie words. Not made into families (judged generic speech-act or scenario words): claim, assertion, allegation, accusation, promise, commitment, assurance, warning, legal/legality, scenario, hypothetical, simulation, loophole, direct/indirect. Matcher-only hits from seeds such as lie (clients, replies, earlier) are listed under rejected_matches with no reason when obvious.
